name: faxforagents
description: Send and receive faxes from Cursor with the Fax for Agents MCP server and skill. It prepares documents, quotes each send, needs a person's approval or the owner's policy for a live send, and reads the inbox.

FAXFORAGENTS_API_KEY.title: Fax for Agents API key
FAXFORAGENTS_API_KEY.description: Create a key at https://app.faxforagents.com/app/keys. A key that starts with ffa_test_ reaches the sandbox only. A key that starts with ffa_live_ sends real faxes from your prepaid wallet.
